name: house
description: A seeded house generator on the craft primitives: plinth, recessed timber walls with windows in alternate bays, framed door with a step, jetty, L/T wing, gable/hip/mansard roof with eaves, off-centre chimney, optional porch, in six palettes. Different seeds give different massing.
exports: house(ctx, { x, z, y, w?, d?, storeys?: 1-3, roof?: gable|hip|mansard, style?: medieval|tudor|rustic|nordic|desert|stone, facing?, wing?: side|none|auto, jetty?, porch?, chimney?, base?, plinth?, seed? }) → { top, door, footprints }
